_meta.description: RAG retrieval evaluation set, built directly from the real indexed catalog (27 documents: 5 products, 8 policies, 8 FAQ, 6 store-info entries), dumped via eval/dump_index.py.
_meta.scoring_note: expected_sources is a LIST because some topics are covered by more than one real document (e.g. policy_shipping and faq_002 both answer shipping-time questions). Retrieving ANY document in the list counts as correct.
_meta.negative_examples: Queries with expected_sources = [] ask about things not in the catalog at all (shoes, kids clothing, discount codes). These test whether retrieval ever confidently returns an irrelevant document rather than nothing.
